code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color in (seen_background := set()):
                pass
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter={(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                       if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if set(comp) != perimeter:
                continue
            interior={(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)}
            if not interior:
                continue
            if any(g[y][x] == color for y,x in interior):
                continue
            fill = 2 if (r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1) == (2,2) else 7
            for y,x in interior:
                g[y][x] = fill
    return g
'''
